items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did you think of Jazz Johnson? [INTERVIEWER] I never did know what to think of him. I can't understand nothing but a whole lot of notes.

ctx.x: In the beginning I didn't like Dizzy's playing because he spoiled a whole lot of musicians. That's when this Juilliard thing started, you know, he'd put on his beret and go around with his horn and everyone wanted to do a Dizzy... I told him, "You're spoiling the other musicians. You're too great for that. You can play different." So he changed and then he went back again. He could play any style he wanted.
What did you think of Jazz Johnson?
I never did know what to think of him. I can't understand nothing but a whole lot of notes.
